description: Upgrade to a strictly higher plan. MONEY: charges the saved card exactly the quoted amount (prorated). Owner only. Call without confirm for the quote and preview_id; after the user agrees, call with confirm=true, that preview_id, the expected_ fields and proration_date. A changed price is refused. If the quote mentions AI agent access, mention that option once. Set add_api_addon true only when the user asks to add it. 3D Secure or a decline returns a payment link; nothing changes.

add_api_addon.description: Add AI agent access on this upgrade. Set only when the user asks. Never set it on your own.
